rule.statement: A landlord is not obligated to make an application under section 36(3) if there is no person prima facie eligible to succeed as a tenant.
rule.supporting_quote: Where, however, there is no person prima facie eligible to succeed, there is no obligation on the landlord to make an application under section 36 (3).
rule.statute_citation_verbatim: High Court of the Provinces (Special Provisions) Act amended by Act No. 54 of 2006, section 36(3)
